tasks.title: Evidence review workspace
tasks.prompt: Create a complex review notebook with at least 7 cells. Overview uses metrics and an illustrative-data notice. A Group selector (All/North/South/West) and Record search jointly filter both the chart and rich table; keep reset discoverable. The rich table has thumbnail, long title, status badge, score, decision select (Pending/Accept/Reject), and Inspect action; sort and pagination must remain after decision changes. Inspect opens selected-record detail tabs (summary, image comparison, JSON). Decisions and a local draft note survive filtering and tab changes; selected view follows the clicked stable id. Include image carousel, highlighted SQL example (no SQL execution needed), full-width Markdown guidance and a scripted local chat explicitly labeled as such. Export all 24 decisions, including filtered-out records. Use families from table/vega/media/carousel/json/markdown/code/chat. Make an empty shared-filter state recoverable. All interactions must be wired. Use the supplied new records, including the long titles; adapt the recipe rather than leaving its example records. No author visual review of normal UI should be needed.

tasks.title: Architecture investigation notebook
tasks.prompt: Create an architecture investigation notebook with at least 7 cells and a 12-node AWS workflow. Use the supplied node descriptions, real matching bundled AWS icons and status badges. Keep nodes readable by default; provide Fit overview and Focus selected actions. Selecting a node by clicking or selector updates a detail inspector with tabs for Summary (Markdown), Properties (JSON), and highlighted SQL/JSON example (code). A local incident note persists between tabs. A health selector (All/Ready/Warning) highlights matching nodes without removing the topology. Include an independently zoomable Mermaid request sequence, a table of services with an Inspect action that selects/focuses the same node, an evidence carousel and full-width operational guide. Flow and Mermaid each open in a canvas-only new tab preserving current view. Export selected id and notes. Sidebar links scroll. Use supplied graph data without backend claims. Use the supplied variant topology and descriptions, not the recipe topology. Keep the graph readable and retained state correct while emphasizing health and selecting distant services.

tasks.title: Visual methods lab
tasks.prompt: Create a complex visual methods notebook with at least 9 cells: overview metrics/notice; linked supplied-point charts with Group filter; a plot-gallery cell with select choosing scatter, line or histogram of supplied fixture values; a scientific Plotly surface (supplied x/y/z) with Surface and Cross section tabs; adjustable JSXGraph geometric construction from the geometry recipe; a browser neural lab from the neural recipe with controls in the left rail and diagnostics/predictions in separate cells; a table of supplied observations with inspect/select; MyST documentation plus highlighted code; and an image carousel. Add canvas-only new-tab snapshots for serializable chart canvases. A local experiment note survives tab changes; the group filter updates both linked charts/table, with reset and empty state. Use at least 8 family packs. Preserve training state during tabs and resize. Use fixtures and recipe computations, no new scientific claims. Prioritize composition, readable chart labels, responsive stateful controls and meaningful action hierarchy. Use the supplied 36-point variant fixture in all linked/gallery/register views. Reuse the complete visual-methods recipe and its theme defaults. Check trained-state resizing and tab round trips with automation.
